race.comment: CONGRESSMAN (4) resumed with a cracking effort in a 1300m Rosehill Midway last start, coming from last to be beaten just 1.5 lengths. Competitive at Group 3 level last prep over the mile behind Skyhook which jumps off the page. Fitter this evening and this looks a perfect set-up second-up. The consistent KOMODO DRAGON (2) comes here off a close second recently in the rich Snake Gully Cup over 1400m at Gundagai. New to this trip but he deserves the benefit of the doubt. UNUSUAL PROSPECT (7) has not raced since July 2025. Very smart when right and is a gun performer when fresh. Keep an eye on the betting. QUARTERBACK (9) finally broke through last start. Yet to race beyond 1400m but he is lightly raced and still improving. STEALTHFIRE (12) caught the eye first up and should be more effective over a bit more ground this evening.
